title: Structured exchange rules v1
description: Rules a project's specifications are reviewed against, for one profile: which attribute values fit together on an item, and across a relationship. Written and validated by people, in the project's own language. Checked against the profile's vocabulary whenever read; never fetched or executed.

profile.description: The identifier of the registered profile these rules apply to.

value.description: One value an attribute may carry: a string, a number or a boolean.

values.description: The values an attribute may take for the condition to hold.

conditions.description: Attribute name to allowed values. Every condition of the set must hold.

clause.description: An item rule's conditions, or a link rule's conditions on its source (`from`) and target (`to`). Which one is checked against the rule's form.

rule.description: An item rule names `element`; a link rule names `relationship`. `when` selects what the rule applies to; `then` is what must hold, or "forbidden".

statement.description: What the rule says, in the project's language — shown in every refusal and report.

source.description: Where the rule comes from: a standard, a clause, a project convention.

level.description: refuse: a violation refuses the document. report: a violation is listed to check.

element.description: The element kind an item rule applies to.

relationship.description: The relationship kind a link rule applies to.
